name: Convatec Group PLC
summary: Convatec Group PLC engages in the development, manufacturing, and sale of medical products, services and technologies for the management of chronic conditions in Europe, North America, and internationally. The company offers advanced wound care products for the management of acute and chronic wounds resulting from various conditions, such as diabetes, and acute conditions resulting from traumatic injury and burns. It also provides ostomy care solutions, including devices, accessories, and services for people with a stoma resulting from colorectal cancer, bladder cancer, inflammatory bowel disease, and trauma.
